ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio between a dominant high-intensity (white) central region and a low-intensity (black) perimeter along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity region spanning approximately 80% of the visible fluke; thin black banding (approx. 5-15 pixels wide) along the trailing edge; concentrated black pigmentation at both distal tips; sparse low-intensity mottling visible near the central-lower ventral area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees; vertical depth from lobe peaks is roughly 12% of total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 3 to 12 pixels, isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct secondary indentation/notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 20 pixels from the median notch apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation on distal tips, with the right tip exhibiting a broader and more continuous low-intensity black region than the left.
